'''Samdew''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Typha-Dor]] who was the communications officer for a surveillance outpost on Typha-Dor's moon, [[TY44]]. He was killed by another member of the crew, [[Mezdec]]. Mezdec told the others that Samdew was a spy from the neighboring world of [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] and said that he was responsible for the deaths of four of the crew members. However, Mezdec was the actual spy.
